# TestScript for 16-live-config-watcher
# Asserts daemon startup, the HTTP /config endpoint, SIGHUP reload via session.Reload,
# live config watching, auxiliary watch.File monitoring, and graceful OS signal shutdown

# 1. Help and Version display
exec watcher-app --help
stdout 'Daemon CLI demonstrating live configuration watching with path expansion'
stdout '-p, --port=8080\s+Server port'

exec watcher-app --version
stdout 'watcher-app has version 1\.0\.0'

# 2. Start daemon HTTP server in the background (config watch + blocklist watch)
exec watcher-app -c config.yaml -p 9090 --blocklist blocklist.txt &server&

# 3. Query initial config via HTTP endpoint (polls until the server is up)
http-wait http://127.0.0.1:9090/config '"rate_limit":\s*500'
stdout '"port":\s*9090'
stdout '"debug":\s*false'
stdout '"blocklist_entries":\s*2'

# 4. SIGHUP triggers a direct session.Reload re-read (no file event, values
#    unchanged); polling the reload counter makes the ordering deterministic
[!windows] hup
[!windows] http-wait http://127.0.0.1:9090/config '"reloads":\s*1\b'
[!windows] stdout '"rate_limit":\s*500'

# 5. Modify config file dynamically to trigger live hot-reload, then poll
# until the daemon serves the reloaded value (no fixed sleeps)
cp config-updated.yaml config.yaml
http-wait http://127.0.0.1:9090/config '"rate_limit":\s*1500'
stdout '"port":\s*9090'
stdout '"debug":\s*true'
[!windows] stdout '"reloads":\s*2\b'

# 6. Auxiliary single-file watch: replacing the blocklist reloads its entry count
cp blocklist-updated.txt blocklist.txt
http-wait http://127.0.0.1:9090/config '"blocklist_entries":\s*3'

# 7. Send interrupt signal to shut down daemon gracefully
# (signal delivery is not supported on Windows; testscript hard-kills leftover background processes)
[!windows] interrupt
[!windows] wait
[!windows] stdout '\[WATCHER\] Loaded config files: \[.*config\.yaml\]'
[!windows] stdout '\[WATCHER\] Blocklist loaded: 2 entries'
[!windows] stdout '\[WATCHER\] SIGHUP reload successful! RateLimit: 500 -> 500'
[!windows] stdout '\[WATCHER\] Live hot-reload successful! RateLimit: 500 -> 1500'
[!windows] stdout '\[WATCHER\] Blocklist reloaded: 3 entries'
[!windows] stdout 'Shutdown signal received, shutting down gracefully\.\.\.'
[!windows] stdout 'Daemon shutting down gracefully'

-- config.yaml --
port: 9090
rate_limit: 500
debug: false

-- config-updated.yaml --
port: 9090
rate_limit: 1500
debug: true

-- blocklist.txt --
10.0.0.7
10.0.0.9

-- blocklist-updated.txt --
10.0.0.7
10.0.0.9
10.0.0.11
